featured_reviews.review_text:
We are extremely happy with our experience at Genius Kidzz Preschool, where my son is enrolled in the toddler program. In just a short time, we have seen a remarkable transformation in him. He has become much more social, his vocabulary has grown significantly, he knows the actions to all the rhymes, and he is now able to identify objects with confidence. Even his tantrums have reduced, and he has become more friendly and comfortable around his peers - something that was not the case earlier.

A special mention to Vrushali Ma’am, who gives undivided and genuine personal attention to each child’s development. The warmth, patience, and care shown by all the teachers truly stand out. Every child is treated with love and respect, making the environment feel safe and nurturing.

As a new mom, I was naturally very anxious about sending my toddler to school since he had never been out of my reach. But choosing Genius Kids Preschool turned out to be one of the best decisions we made. I’m so glad we trusted the school and its wonderful teachers - it has been absolutely worth it. 💛

The various activities like Day Trips, Annual Celebrations, Color Day, Vegetable Day, and Fruits Day were not only exciting but also very educational. These events helped the children learn practically while boosting their confidence and participation.

What impressed us the most is the focus on Fine motor skills , overall development and good habits. The school has played a big role in teaching my children healthy eating habits, proper table manners, discipline, and basic self-care skills like potty training. They have also learned the values of sharing, caring, and respecting others at such a young age.

We have seen a remarkable improvement in their communication, social behavior, and confidence. The teachers are caring, patient, and truly dedicated to each child’s growth.

Because of this wonderful experience, we are happily continuing with Genius Kiddz for Nursery as well. Thank you for nurturing our children with so much love, care, and dedication. Highly recommended to all parents looking for a strong and joyful foundation for their kids! - Mrs.Minal kadam

The first few days were challenging, as expected, but the transformation we've witnessed over the last months has been nothing short of remarkable.

The most significant change we've seen is in his social confidence. Earlier, Krushnang was quite hesitant around other children. Now, he not only greets his teachers and friends with excitement but is also starting to share his toys and participate in group activities. He's learning the building blocks of friendship, and it's a joy to watch.

This newfound confidence isn't just social; it's a part of his entire personality. He's more curious, tries to do things on his own, and isn't afraid to voice his likes and dislikes in his own little ways. We are convinced that the secure, nurturing, and stimulating environment you provide at Genius Kidzz is the key to this wonderful growth.

Thank you for helping our little boy blossom.
